name: guitar-tuner
description: Free offline guitar tuner with the largest open song→tuning catalog: 27,800+ songs by 857 artists across 573 tunings and 18 scenes worldwide — including the Russian alt scene no other database covers. Target-constrained pitch detection, physically modelled reference tones. No signup, no ads.

paragraphs: A fast, free guitar tuner with a curated library of 4,500 alternate tunings for specific songs, across 91 artists — including a corner of the Russian alternative scene that no other tuning database covers.
Pick a song, see the tuning it was recorded in, retune, play. No account, no signup, no paywall, no ads. Installs to your home screen and works with no signal.

Most tuners handle E standard and a handful of drop tunings. The annoying part of playing metal isn't the tuning itself, it's finding out which tuning a song uses, which usually means digging through tab sites and forum threads that contradict each other.
features: verified — cross-checked against multiple independent sources, shown with a badge
unmarked — commonly reported, but not independently confirmed
c — sources genuinely disagree; both readings are kept and the UI says so
unusual — the tuning really is strange, deliberately so, and is not a data error
